_doc: Where the manual lane runs for this channel (read by src/autoslice/manual_lane/layout.py; each key can be overridden by MANUAL_LANE_<KEY>, nested keys joined by _). Replace every replace_me before use; keys starting with _ are notes. See profiles/SETUP.md.
_archive_root: Recordings as the media host sees them: <archive_root>/<room id>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<name>.flv|.mp4 and the chat <name>.xml beside each. discover looks here.
_danmaku_host: Where the controller fetches a recording's chat .xml over ssh: an ssh alias reachable FROM THE CONTROLLER (it may be the media host's alias), with danmaku_root = the same recordings root as that host sees it.
_cover_font: The cover font file on the media host. Empty: <work_root>/assets/fonts/RuiZiZhenYan.ttf, which is not shipped; either put a font there under that name or give the full path on the media host of another font file here (assets/<profile>/fonts has open fonts; after syncing they are under <autoslice_base>/current/repo/assets/<profile>/fonts).
_intro_dir: Directory of the branding intro clips on the media host. Empty: <work_root>/assets/intro. A channel without an intro turns the intro off in its branding-intro asset.
_search_mcp_url: Optional: a Search Router MCP address for looking up works and in-circle references. Empty: no web lookup.
_speaker_v8: The channel's voiceprint workspace. Leave all four empty until you have one: a clip where only the host speaks does not use it; a clip with a guest or a watched video stops at step 4 and says so.
